```{r}
rm(list = ls())
library(vegan)

# Define the pairwise.adonis2 function with strata support
pairwise.adonis2 <- function(dist_obj, factors, strata = NULL, p.adjust.m = "bonferroni", permutations = 9999) {

    if (!inherits(dist_obj, "dist")) {
    stop("dist_obj must be a 'dist' object.")
  }
  
  unique_factors <- unique(as.character(factors))
  co <- combn(unique_factors, 2)
  
  pairs <- c()
  F.Model <- c()
  R2 <- c()
  p.value <- c()
  
  # Loop over each pair
  for (elem in 1:ncol(co)) {
    sub_idx <- factors %in% c(co[1, elem], co[2, elem])
    
    sub_dist <- as.matrix(dist_obj)[sub_idx, sub_idx]  
    sub_dist <- as.dist(sub_dist)  # Back to dist
    sub_factors <- droplevels(as.factor(factors[sub_idx]))
    sub_strata <- if (!is.null(strata)) strata[sub_idx] else NULL
    
    # Run adonis2 for the pair
    ad <- adonis2(sub_dist ~ sub_factors, strata = sub_strata, permutations = permutations)
    
    # Collect results
    pairs <- c(pairs, paste(co[1, elem], "vs", co[2, elem], sep = " "))
    F.Model <- c(F.Model, ad$F[1])
    R2 <- c(R2, ad$R2[1])
    p.value <- c(p.value, ad$`Pr(>F)`[1])
  }
  
  # Adjust p-values
  p.adjusted <- p.adjust(p.value, method = p.adjust.m)
  
  # Add significance codes
  sig <- rep("", length(p.adjusted))
  sig[p.adjusted <= 0.05] <- "."
  sig[p.adjusted <= 0.01] <- "*"
  sig[p.adjusted <= 0.001] <- "**"
  sig[p.adjusted <= 0.0001] <- "***"
  
  # Create results data frame
  res <- data.frame(
    pairs = pairs,
    F.Model = F.Model,
    R2 = R2,
    p.value = p.value,
    p.adjusted = p.adjusted,
    sig = sig
  )
  
  # Print significance codes legend
  cat("Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1\n")
  
  return(res)
}

```

```{r}

library(qiime2R)


metadata<-read_q2metadata("../artifacts//metadata.tsv")
dist_obj <-read_qza("../artifacts/diversities/weighted_unifrac_distance_matrix.qza")
dist_mat<- as.dist(dist_obj$data)

sample_names <- attr(dist_mat, "Labels")
meta_ordered <- metadata[match(sample_names, metadata$SampleID), ]
stopifnot(all(meta_ordered$sampleid == sample_names))

results <- pairwise.adonis2(
  dist_obj = dist_mat,
  factors = meta_ordered$visit,
  strata = meta_ordered$`subject-id`,
  p.adjust.m = "fdr",  
  permutations = 9999
)

write.csv(
  as.data.frame(results),
  file = "../export/weighted_unifrac_pairwise_adonis.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

```
